move: colour rows snap in from the left as slivers that stretch open, light sweeps down, each row swells, rows shoot off
how: A small header and six full-width colour rows, each with a name, hex and role text and a white overlay swipe div at scaleX 0. 0-6%: the header drops in. 1.5-20%: the rows slide in from xPercent -104 (move, 0.8s) while stretching from scaleY .2 (0.6s), 0.12s stagger; from 4.5% the names slide from xPercent -30 and from 5.5% the meta from x 40, both fading in with the same stagger. 22-55%: a light sweep runs down the list, each row 0.55s apart: the swipe scales 0->1 from the left (expo.out) then collapses to the right (expo.in) while the row bumps scale 1.02 and back. 58-88%: each row in turn grows height 86->118 as its name scales 1.18 from the left (expo.out) then returns (expo.inOut), 0.5s apart. Exit at 91.5%: the rows shoot off to xPercent 106 bottom-first (expo.in, 0.07s stagger) and the header lifts out.
adapt: Replace the six row colours, names, hex codes and role labels and the header text; row count can change (the sweep and swell cadence scale with it). Keep the 0.12s entrance stagger, the 0.55s sweep cadence and the 0.5s swell cadence.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the header and rows from shot.palette inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with entrance 0.015D-0.2D, sweep 0.22D-0.55D, swell 0.58D-0.88D, exit at 0.915D. Scope '.row', '.head', '.swipe' to el; all from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested; animating height forces layout on each frame.
caveats: mix-blend-mode: overlay on the swipe divs
animating row height reflows the list each frame
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested
ends empty, no return to frame one
